Hi everyone

I'd like to plot a bar chart similar to a boxplot. In my dataframe there are two columns giving min and max values of a variable. I want the bars start/end from that values and not from 0. You can see the intended plot at http://stackoverflow.com/q/29916770/709777

Is it possible to build this plot with geom_bar? any other geom? maybe geom_polygon?

Thanks in advance

On Tue, Apr 28, 2015 at 1:18 PM, CEAM Meteorología <cea...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi and thanks for answering. geom_text works for what I needed.

Please, find attached code, maybe could be useful for someone else

datap1=cbind.data.frame(data1$ESTACION,data1$MAXIMO_HORARIO,data1$MINIMO_HORARIO)
names(datap1) <- c("estacion","Maximo_horario","Minimo_horario")

dataplot1 <- melt(datap1,id.vars='estacion')

plot1=ggplot(datap1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=estacion, xend=estacion, y=Minimo_horario, yend=Maximo_horario), size=3,color="orange") +
  xlab(" ") + ylab("Castellón") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=80, size=8, hjust=1, vjust=1),legend.position="none") +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,200),breaks=c(0,50,100,150,200)) +
  theme(plot.margin=unit(c(1,1,0,0),"mm")) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=mean((datap1$Maximo_horario + datap1$Minimo_horario)/2, na.rm=TRUE), color="red") +
  ggtitle(paste("Ozono - Oscilación diaria - ",format(Sys.time(), "%d/%m/%Y"),sep=""))
